description: This file defines the class PointerLocationEvaluator, which implements a JSON pointer relative position evaluator based on a reference JSON pointer. It determines if a given JSON pointer is above, below, the same level, or different from the reference pointer.

classes.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
classes.description: A final class implementing a function to evaluate the relative location of a JSON pointer compared to a reference pointer.

methods.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the evaluator with a reference JSON pointer.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Evaluates the position of the given JSON pointer relative to the reference pointer and returns a PointerLocation enum value.

methods.name: isOnReferencePointer
methods.description: Checks if the evaluation pointer is on the reference pointer, i.e., shares the same path up to the reference's level.
